stem: Meera places a healthy potted money plant in a dark cupboard at home in Pune for one day. Which process will the plant's cells continue to carry out in all its parts, including the roots, to release energy?

teacher.key_rationale: Respiration occurs in all living plant cells, green and non-green, day and night, breaking down glucose with oxygen to release carbon dioxide, water and energy. In the dark, photosynthesis stops, so A fails. Transpiration and translocation are transport processes, not energy-releasing ones, and they do not occur meaningfully in root cells in this context.
